create.name: Emma Estrela
create.bio:
Emma Estrela is a breathwork teacher and lucid dreaming guide who lives in the Lake District in north-west England. She first travelled to Poland to train in the Wim Hof Method in 2016, went on to become one of its advanced instructors and a lead trainer at its academy, and has spent close to ten years guiding breathing sessions, cold-water immersions and retreats across Europe and the United States, at times alongside the breath writer James Nestor.

Her more recent path runs through yoga nidra and dreaming. Trained as a lucid dreaming facilitator by Charlie Morley and drawn to Tibetan dream yoga, she began exploring the dream state seriously after her late mother appeared to her in a lucid dream, and she now treats waking awareness and dreaming as one continuous practice. She works one to one in person and online, combining conversation, breath, body awareness and dream practice, and offers longer mentorships for people who want ongoing support. Her weekends in the Cumbrian fells pair breathing practice with waterfall and lake swims, and her YouTube channel mixes guided breathing with reflective films made at the water's edge.

courses.title: Private 1:1 with Emma
courses.description: A ninety-minute private session, in person or online, that starts from what is going on for you and then draws on whatever fits: conversation and self-inquiry, breathing practice, body awareness, sleep and dream work. Three- and six-month mentorships are offered for those who want to continue.

courses.title: Lake District Retreat | Chasing Waterfalls Weekend UK
courses.description: A weekend in a Cumbrian valley near Kendal spent outdoors, visiting waterfalls and natural pools and practising breathwork, cold-water immersion and simple awareness exercises. The pace is gentle rather than competitive, with time left for rest and reflection.

courses.title: Poland - Wim Hof Winter Experience with Michelle Riordan
courses.description: A six-day winter journey to the Karkonosze mountains, co-led with fellow senior instructor Michelle Riordan, with daily breathing sessions, waterfall immersions and a group ascent of Śnieżka in snow. It is framed around self-trust and steadiness rather than feats of endurance, with transport from Prague airport included.

free_resources.title: Free 3 Online Videos
free_resources.description: A short free video series, unlocked with an email address, that introduces the basics of breathing practice, cold exposure and paying closer attention to how you feel. A gentle first step before a session or retreat.
